description:
Vendelux is transforming how companies discover, evaluate, and maximize the impact of events.

Event marketers are the driving force behind pipeline and brand — yet events remain one of the least optimized and most opaque marketing channels. Vendelux changes that. We provide the system of record for event marketing, giving teams the data and insights they need to make smarter, more strategic decisions.

Our AI-powered platform delivers proprietary insights across 250,000+ events, helping high-growth companies identify where their ideal customers will be, maximize ROI, and turn events into a scalable growth channel. Customers often describe Vendelux as an event marketer’s dream. A key part of this is our growing network of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party attendee and sponsorship data, and in return gain access to valuable market insights.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings helps customers turn event insights into action — using AI to identify high-value attendees and automatically book 1:1 meetings with the right prospects at conferences. This allows teams to maximize pipeline generation and make every event materially more impactful.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series A SaaS company backed by leading investors including FirstMark, with a recent $14M round. Our team brings experience from companies like Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, Compass, Forter, Airbnb, and more.
________________
We are offering a paid internship to an entry-level person looking to break into tech and startups. This is an onsite NYC role for a local college or MBA student who can commit around 20+ hours/week during the winter/spring semester. This could develop into a full-time role for the right person.
The intern will handle various administrative, research, or data operations tasks for the marketing and data teams. For candidates with the right background, projects may include data analytics and insights using SQL.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist with event research to identify and validate key data inputs for AI models

• Review and resolve data errors in the database; collaborate with team on patterns and potential signals

• Use SQL and dashboarding tools to perform data analysis to identify insights about events, attendees, and organizations attending events

• Leverage AI-enabled tools to generate and manage sensitive datasets

Qualifications
• Based in New York City and able to work from our midtown office

• Available ~20+ hours per week

• Detail-oriented with high level of ownership

• Can-do attitude willing to take on whatever projects are needed

Why Join Us
• Direct product impact: Your models will shape how event marketers discover, connect, and measure ROI.

• Product market fit: Customers love our platform; now it’s about enhancing the user experience and scaling with AI.

• Ownership: You’ll set the standard for how we build, evaluate, and ship AI at Vendelux.

• Growth: Work on cutting-edge problems in LLMs, recommendation systems, and applied ML.

Team: Join a collaborative, ambitious group with backgrounds at top tech and consulting firms.
Not all candidates will check all of the requirements listed above and that’s ok! We are open to great people from non-traditional backgrounds.

Department DescriptionThe Genomics group is part of GSK’s Cellular Biomarkers Platform Sciences organization and supports translational and clinical research across the R&D portfolio by providing strategic and technical leadership to clinical and research teams across advanced assay platforms - including genomics, transcriptomics, spatial transcriptomics, and next‑generation proteomics - supporting informed biomarker selection and study design. Job Description
We are seeking a summer intern to support data quality control, processing, and exploratory analysis for genomics and next‑generation proteomics platforms. The selected candidate will work with structured biological datasets, contribute to standardized QC and data processing workflows, and gain hands‑on exposure to data infrastructure and basic automation or AI‑enabled approaches. This role provides practical experience in how scientific data is curated, validated, and prepared for downstream analysis in an industry R&D environment.

The selected candidate’s responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

Contributing to the development, testing, or refinement of primary analysis or QC scripts under guidance from senior team members.
Assisting with data cleaning, transformation, and processing using Python or R to prepare datasets for downstream analysis and reporting.
Conducting basic exploratory data analysis and generating summary statistics and visualizations to assess data quality and trends.
Supporting organization of databases in shared repositories to enable traceability, version control, and reproducibility.
Assisting with documentation of data workflows, QC outcomes, and analysis assumptions.
Gaining introductory exposure to automation or AI‑enabled approaches for data QC under close supervision.
Participating in team meetings and presenting progress, QC findings, or small analyses to a scientific audience as appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications

Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Data Science/Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Familiarity with common data manipulation, visualization, and analysis libraries in Python/R (e.g., pandas / tidyverse) and Linux systems or MATLAB through coursework or projects.
Must be able to work full-time (35-40 hours/week) throughout the duration of the 12 week internship (May/June ~ August 2026).
Must have an active student status and/or within 12 months post-graduation from a BS or MS degree program. Post-doctoral candidates are not eligible.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to reproducible analysis practices (e.g., scripts, structured documentation, basic version control) and working in notebooks (e.g., Jupyter or R Markdown)
Familiarity with basic Genomics wet-lab concepts and techniques such as DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, and next-generation sequencing.
Exposure to basic bioinformatics or high-dimensional biology data concepts (e.g., matrices, normalization concepts, dimensionality reduction/cluster visualization) through coursework or independent learning.
Familiarity with using AI/ML libraries such as OpenAI or Scikit-learn.

Eligibility Requirements

Must successfully pass a drug screen and background check prior to assignment target start date.

Please note: If you do not receive an automated email after submitting your application, be sure to check your spam folder.
